caption:
You’re just enduring. Real life later? (1 Timothy 6:12, 16)

“Take hold of the eternal life to which you were called.” It’s a command for today, resting on a calling already complete. This life has already begun — you’re not waiting in line outside it.

And this life doesn’t rest on your grip. “He alone has immortality” (6:16). Christ gave Himself as a ransom for all (2:6); the life you hold is His to give and His to keep.
